parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `MockStructuredAnalytics.CPUSessionEventProxy+Playback` declared in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift` — both the `AnalyticsTesting` path segment and the `Mock` type-name prefix are unambiguous mock-fixture markers. The high Jaccard similarity of 0.875 is expected and intentional: the mock is designed to mirror the shape of the production `CPUSessionEvent` in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift` so that test code can substitute it. Extracting shared structure would couple `PlaybackCore` production semantics to test-infrastructure semantics, which is precisely the anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. No refactor is warranted.
